title: Implement header block builder — verbatim RFC 5536 wire bytes to raw IPLD block
description: Produce a raw IPLD block (CIDv1 SHA-256) from verbatim RFC 5536 article header bytes. No parsing, no transformation. The header bytes are the exact bytes received from the NNTP wire or produced by the POST path.
notes: Size: S. Depends on Issue A (Define article root node DAG-CBOR schema).
